title: Fabien Pinckaers, founder & CEO of Odoo, recommended Incorruptible to a visitor at Odoo Experience 2026 in Brussels
summary: Mikail Yilmaz — founder of Repair IT Now, a Dutch circular IT-lifecycle company — met Odoo founder and CEO Fabien Pinckaers at Odoo Experience 2026 in Brussels, told him about his business, and was recommended two books: Never Split the Difference and Incorruptible. The photo is taken at the conference's 'Fabien's book selection' wall. Yilmaz then applies the book to his own scaling problem: making the mission as true for customer one hundred as it was for customer one.
blockquote:
Op Odoo Experience 2026 in Brussel ontmoette ik Fabien Pinckaers, oprichter en CEO van Odoo. Ik vertelde hem over Repair IT Now. Hij raadde me twee boeken aan:
→ Never Split the Difference – Chris Voss
→ Incorruptible – Eric Ries
attribution_title: Founder, Repair IT Now · Circular IT lifecycle partner, Netherlands
